resources.string: How far the price sits under its 20-day high (resistance) • minus = a breakout above the high
The gap between the highest and lowest price over the chosen weeks • small = a quiet stock, neither up nor down much
Above (+) or below (-) the 50-day average • plus = uptrend
A blend of breakout setup, trend, volume, liquidity and momentum • %1$s+ STRONG, %2$s+ WATCH
